property_summary: The pot must always be zero after a win (random==0), otherwise it holds the accumulated ticket amounts; the bugby version always wins, so pot is always reset to zero after every play call, whereas the reference resets it only when random favors the win, violating the invariant that pot should non-deterministically remain non-zero.
change_summary: Change win condition to always true by setting random = 0, always draining the pot.
